title: Cinderhead Mine - Crystal Gallery
_note: Option C relit / Light-leaning variant. gbc 4-voice band. 82bpm, 4/4, A minor warming toward C major (relative-major lift). Brighter bell-timbre pulse25 lead - the crystal chime promoted to lead, an ascending sparkle line, hopeful; pulse12 glassy ascending bell arpeggios catching light (Light signature), fuller than A; tri_bass drone that rises stepwise to the relative major and warms; soft drums pick-tap, a bright chime-shimmer (ohat) at the seam. Vesper states the spine ascending into the relative-major lift: E3->A3->B3 ... then resolving up C5->B4->C5, the overshoot finally allowed to land bright - the east region's hopeful 'discovery' beat. 24-bar loop, voice-leads home.
key: A minor warming to C major

tracks.name: lead
tracks._note: Bright bell-timbre lead, ascending sparkle, hopeful. Vesper ascends: E3->A3->B3 stated low then the line climbs; the settle lands bright C5->B4->C5 in the relative major. Starts in the cave's low register, rises to the gallery's gleam.
